title: Per-registration OSCORE Observe
close_reason: Needs design decision: Task has no description. Existing secure channel has basic OSCORE observe tracking infrastructure (_RequestCorrelation with request_id and observe flag in channel.py). Specific requirements for per-registration OSCORE Observe need to be defined (e.g., separate OSCORE contexts per registration, B.1.2 Echo recovery per RFC 8613, or id_context per observe token).
